# Alex Rowan — fictional career source
Northstar Software | Platform Engineer | March 2019–June 2022
Northstar Software | Senior Platform Engineer | July 2022–November 2025
In 2023 I designed the Cedar deployment rehearsal format. I co-built the runner with three other engineers. Two product teams adopted it. We did not measure financial savings or deployment failure reduction. I did not manage those engineers.
In 2024 I mentored two graduate engineers through Willow design-review sessions. They later facilitated the reviews themselves. They were not my direct reports. This mentoring is work I am particularly proud of.
Completed the Safe Systems training course with Learning Grove in 2023. It was a course, not a professional certification; no certification exam was taken.
